verses.1: It was the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah, the prophet, to the Philistines, before Pharaoh would attack Gaza.
verses.2: So said Jehovah: “Now, waters will rise from the depths, and they will become rivers that flow over the land. The earth will be filled with abundance, and cities will be built upon it. But people will cry out in despair, and all those who live on the earth will wail.”
verses.3: From the sound of his steeds’ hoofbeats, his charioteers rushed forward. His wheels moved forward, but his parents did not turn their hands towards their children from fear.
verses.4: Today, the Lord has rescued all the Philistines from destruction. All those who were defeated have been saved, just as Jehovah rescued the Philistines from their captivity.
verses.5: A snowstorm came to Azah. It seemed like Ashkelon was covered in snow, so deep that it could not be seen anymore.
verses.6: Oh, how miserable is this situation! I will not rest until I get rid of this torment. I will not endure this pain any longer.
verses.7: How can she be calm, when Jehovah has commanded her to go to Ashkelon and to the shore by the sea? That’s where she will be sent.
